_comment: READ-AND-RELEASE coverage (the user's 'tally + chase-release'): 3 drones run track_convoy in COVERAGE mode over convoy_px4 (SIM-5 world: ONE gz server, 5 RoboMaster cars ids 7/11/23/42/88, 1 onboard cam/drone @5 Hz -> RTF ~0.86). Unlike sitl3_track_vision.json (one drone hard-pinned to one car via track_marker_ids), here track_marker_ids is null (ANY id) and a shared ConvoyRegistry (auto-built because the phase is track_convoy, seeded from convoy_ids) dedups: each drone ACQUIREs whatever unread car it can claim, chases only until it has read_confirm_hits consistent reads (disengage_on_read), then release(serviced=True) and peels off to the next unread car. When idle (nothing claimable in view) search_when_idle flies a body-frame box loiter (Move FORWARD search_leg_cm, Hover search_dwell_s, Rotate 90 deg, repeat) so a NEW car drifts into the nadir footprint instead of giving up. The orchestrator prints CONVOY COVERAGE serviced N/5 + seen N/5 + per-id reads (SEEN = decoded at all; SERVICED = locked+confirmed+released) and, once all 5 are SERVICED, signals an all-serviced EARLY-STOP that lands every drone cleanly before mission_budget_s. This is the chase fallback to the blind lawnmower (sitl3_lawn_vision.json): use it when a moving/evasive (RC) car needs an active read the fixed sweep undercovers; the lawnmower remains the primary read-everything. SEARCH GEOMETRY (gate-E tunable, OPEN-LOOP yaw drift compounds): a fixed-leg + 90 deg turn traces a closed square of side ~search_leg_cm, so each drone LOITERS a region near its spawn (alpha 1.2,0.2 / bravo -1.2,0.2 / charlie 0,-2 in run_vision.sh) watching for cars to pass — NOT an expanding sweep; the registry dedup means overlapping boxes still split the 5 cars. SITL footprint is large (h~2.4 m, hfov 99.69 deg -> ~5.7 m wide) so a 3 m box keeps cars in view; REAL HULA onsite (h~1.0 m under the ~1.1 m ceiling, hfov ~71 deg -> ~1.43 m footprint) needs a SMALLER search_leg_cm (~120 cm) + tighter read range — retune search_leg_cm/search_dwell_s + approach_cm at gate E, do NOT ship the SITL numbers to the field. read_confirm_hits 2: the LOCK already required acquire_hits=3 in-window reads, so 2 more TRACK reads = a confident, consistent decode without over-chasing the thin-margin car (id 11 read only 2x in the lawn3 sweep). approach_enabled true: sim is where open-loop translation is proven; OFF on real HULA until gate E. BANDS 2.6/2.4/2.2 distinct (sitl vertical-separation guard, NOT a real deconfliction plan: the ~1.1 m arena ceiling kills altitude bands -> onsite deconfliction is TIME slots + SPACE sectors, set at gate D). CONVOY: all 5 cars drive (run_vision.sh read5: CONVOY_IDS='7 11 23 42 88', CONVOY_LINEAR 0.08, CONVOY_DELAY 150 holds them at spawn through the EKF settle). Transport/endpoints/ports identical to sitl3_lawn_vision.json. Run via sim/run_vision.sh read5.

track_convoy._comment: COVERAGE mode: track_marker_ids null (any id, registry dedups). disengage_on_read services a car after 2 TRACK reads then re-acquires the next; search_when_idle loiters a ~3 m box (GATE-E: ~120 cm onsite). height_cm omitted -> band 260 cm.
